_comment: Emit config (P1/D30). The typecheck config inherits noEmit from the shared
base; this one turns emission on for `pnpm run build`, which the package's
node:test suite and every downstream Node consumer (apps/api at P4) load.
rootDir is the package root so ../scene.schema.json — imported by
src/validate.ts — is emitted to dist/scene.schema.json, keeping the relative
specifier valid in both the source tree and dist.
